searchText: Huh. Stray thought. Has there been any talk of some sort of spawn option where you could spin off another validitor from your already in contract consolidated eth earnings from a set of validators? That would be basically this proposal from <@!755590043632140352> https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2763 Yep, that'd do it. I remember talk from the time and hadn't realized it'd been proposed.
